The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe, the popular payment processing platform, operates in 46 countries, but its restrictions in many regions leave digital creators searching for alternative solutions. PayPal, another well-known platform, is also not available in many countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, where its suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, popular e-commerce platforms, are also restricted in various countries, pushing creators to seek out infrastructure that can bypass these limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

While PayPal's suspension can take up to 180 days, even if the account is reinstated, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy's restrictions mean creators in these countries cannot access their services at all, forcing them to rely on manual workarounds or expensive third-party solutions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), can be deployed in restricted countries, offering a permanent structural alternative to these platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments, a key component of the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than the fees charged by Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy. Furthermore, with NOWPayments, creators can choose from over 300 cryptocurrencies and recommended networks for low fees, such as BSC, Solana, and TRON, which can process transactions for under $0.10.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to own their entire digital commerce stack.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

In stark contrast to the platform-centric approach of Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy, sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to own their entire digital commerce stack, including hosting, backend logic, order storage, and file delivery, giving them complete control and flexibility. With sovereign infrastructure, creators can automate payment processing, delivery, and analytics, freeing themselves from manual workarounds and the limitations of traditional e-commerce platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

To determine the best architecture for your situation, first, assess your current infrastructure and payment processing needs. Next, consider the level of control and flexibility you require, as well as your budget and scalability needs. By weighing these factors, you can choose the right architecture and implementation approach, such as deploying the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or developing a custom sovereign commerce solution.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee.

For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other countries restricted by Stripe, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a robust and scalable solution for selling digital products, with 30-day support and a comprehensive set of features, including automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and recommended networks for low fees. To learn more about this solution, visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce stack, follow these steps: (1) choose a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; (2) select a backend logic solution, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; (3) configure your order storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets; (4) set up your file delivery solution, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; (5) integrate automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, such as NOWPayments; and (6) deploy your stack and test it end-to-end before handoff.
